import json, os, subprocess

plan = _items[0]["json"]
root = "/home/node/files/films/" + plan["slug"]
fps = int(plan["fps"])
rdir = os.path.join(root, "render", "seedance")
os.makedirs(rdir, exist_ok=True)

for shot in plan["shots"]:
    sid = shot["id"]
    out = os.path.join(rdir, sid + ".mp4")
    # 720p 16:9 clip -> 1080p, no letterboxing; yuv420p + fixed fps so every
    # segment is stream-compatible for the concat demuxer.
    vf = ("[0:v]scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1920:1080,"
          "fps=" + str(fps) + ",format=yuv420p[v]")
    # A clip generated before native audio was enabled has no audio stream.
    # Inject silence so every segment carries exactly one audio stream.
    pr = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "a",
                         "-show_entries", "stream=index", "-of", "csv=p=0", shot["clip"]],
                        capture_output=True, text=True)
    has_audio = bool(pr.stdout.strip())
    args = ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-i", shot["clip"]]
    if has_audio:
        fc = vf
        maps = ["-map", "[v]", "-map", "0:a:0"]
        tail = []
    else:
        # anullsrc is an infinite source — -shortest clips it to the video length.
        args += ["-f", "lavfi", "-i", "anullsrc=r=48000:cl=stereo"]
        fc = vf
        maps = ["-map", "[v]", "-map", "1:a:0"]
        tail = ["-shortest"]
    args += ["-filter_complex", fc] + maps + [
        "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "veryfast", "-crf", "18", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
        "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k", "-ar", "48000", "-ac", "2",
    ] + tail + [out]
    pr = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if pr.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("ffmpeg normalise failed for " + sid + ": " + (pr.stderr or "")[-300:])

plan["ok"] = True
plan["clips"] = len(plan["shots"])
plan["rendered_dir"] = rdir
return [{"json": plan}]

import base64, datetime, json, os, subprocess

item = _items[0]["json"]
plan = item["plan"]
slug = item["slug"]
root = "/home/node/files/films/" + slug
rdir = plan["rendered_dir"]

# subs.srt is always written; burn_subs decides only whether it is composited in.
with open(os.path.join(root, "subs.srt"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    fh.write(item["srt"])

film = os.path.join(root, "film.mp4")
vf = "[0:v]format=yuv420p[v]"
if plan.get("burn_subs"):
    style = "FontSize=%d,Outline=1,Shadow=0,MarginV=28" % int(plan.get("font_size") or 24)
    vf = "[0:v]subtitles=" + os.path.join(root, "subs.srt") + ":force_style='" + style + "',format=yuv420p[v]"

# Raw Seedance clips cannot be stream-copied together: they may differ in sample
# rate, channel layout, frame rate and timebase, and some carry no audio at all.
# Normalise Clips already forced every segment to 1080p/<fps> yuv420p + 48kHz
# stereo AAC, so here we decode the list through a filter graph and re-encode
# once, which keeps A/V sync and timestamps correct across boundaries.
args = ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", "list.txt"]
music = (plan.get("music_file") or "").strip()
if music:
    mp = music if os.path.isabs(music) else os.path.join(root, "music", os.path.basename(music))
    if not os.path.exists(mp):
        raise RuntimeError("music file not found: " + mp)
    args += ["-stream_loop", "-1", "-i", mp]
    vol = plan.get("music_volume", 0.15)
    fc = vf + ";[1:a]volume=" + str(vol) + "[m];[0:a][m]amix=inputs=2:duration=first:dropout_transition=0[a]"
    args += ["-filter_complex", fc, "-map", "[v]", "-map", "[a]"]
else:
    args += ["-filter_complex", vf, "-map", "[v]", "-map", "0:a"]
args += ["-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "medium", "-crf", "18",
         "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k", "-ar", "48000", "-ac", "2",
         "-movflags", "+faststart", film]
pr = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=rdir)
if pr.returncode != 0:
    raise RuntimeError("final encode failed: " + (pr.stderr or "")[-300:])

pr = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration,size", "-of", "json", film],
                    capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
meta = json.loads(pr.stdout)
duration = round(float(meta["format"]["duration"]), 2)
size_mb = round(int(meta["format"]["size"]) / 1048576, 2)

now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z"
pf = os.path.join(root, "project.json")
proj = json.load(open(pf)) if os.path.exists(pf) else {}
proj.update({"status": "rendered", "updated_at": now})
# Same key film-05 uses: both assemblies produce film.mp4, only one runs per
# project. `mode` records which engine ran without breaking load-by-slug.
proj.setdefault("stages", {})["assembly"] = {
    "status": "done",
    "done_at": now,
    "mode": "seedance",
    "shots": len(plan["shots"]),
    "burn_subs": bool(plan.get("burn_subs")),
    "duration_seconds": duration,
    "size_mb": size_mb,
}
with open(pf, "w") as fh:
    json.dump(proj, fh, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

return [{"json": {"ok": True, "film": film, "duration": duration, "size_mb": size_mb}}]
